text.title: Clashing Banners
text.body: The valley before Harborwatch has devolved into predatory madness. Two massive rival armies—the Ironclad Banner to the west and the fanatical Ashen Banner to the east—slaughter each other over boarding manifests while executing refugees caught in the crossfire. Harbor Marshal Veyra orders both warbands crushed.
text.msg.1: Every ship has a waterline, and those vultures butcher refugees over boarding berths! Bait the Ironclad and Ashen banners into bleeding each other white, then sweep the field!
text.msg.2: War-horns sound from both ridges—rival vanguards collide across the muddy valley!
text.msg.3: The Ironclad Banner lies trampled in the mud; our scouts seize their vanguard strongbox of seven hundred florins!
text.msg.4: The Ashen Banner shatters in retreat; captured from their burning command pavilion are seven hundred gold sovereigns!
text.msg.5: Both rival banners lie trampled in the mud. The final road into Harborwatch's war-docks is open!
text.win: Both predatory banners are broken and the final road into Harborwatch stands open.
text.fail.1: Your hero fell between the clashing banners.
